segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Teen din se bukhar hai aur badan me dard hai. Khansi bilkul nahi hai.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Yeh viral fever lag raha hai.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Aap Paracetamol 650 mg TDS lijiye 3 din tak khana khane ke baad.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Agar aaram na mile to Complete Blood Count (CBC) test karwa lena.
